releaseNotes:
• Saturated True Blue (Today) vs Pure Neutral Grey (No Duty) UI: Removed blue slate tint from Off-Duty grey so Today (vivid blue), Tomorrow (green), and No Duty (neutral grey) are unmistakably distinct!
• Telugu Voice Readout Default OFF: Post-siren Tanglish voice readout now defaults to OFF (toggle ON anytime in-app).
• Cleaner In-App Layout: Removed preset employee ID chips, old default extra IDs, and empty space above the in-app widget card (while keeping Home Screen widget bottom-anchored).
